note: Word list for the Chinese interface of Antigravity (see l10n.mjs). exact: a whole text and its Chinese form. patterns: [regular expression, replacement] for texts with variable parts. inline: mixed-element paragraph templates with {1}..{n} child-element slots. A part of the entries comes from the project antigravity-chinese (MIT license, https://github.com/yiheng8023/antigravity-chinese); every entry has been re-reviewed for natural Chinese UI phrasing and terminology consistency. Industry acronyms and product names (MCP, API, Git, JSON, URL, LLM token) stay in English; UI concepts (Agent, Subagent, Skill, Artifact, Worktree, Diff, Hook, etc.) are fully localized.
